description: The dataset consists of resting-state electroencephalogram (EEG) data in dat format from 32 healthy individuals and 59 patients with consciousness disorders. Each data segment comprises 60 epochs, with each epoch lasting 2 seconds. There are 62 electrode points, and the sampling rate is 250 Hz.
citation: ling (2023). The raw data of resting EEG of patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness. figshare. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.23552964.v4
title: The raw data of resting EEG of patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness
